desc:
Play the Adoption 2, the sequel of this game here! 
https://www.roblox.com/games/9011308406/Adoption-2-STORY#!/store

A group of 6-12 friends get adopted into a new rich family. What can go wrong when these parents decide to adopt them? Play through this suspenseful, thrilling adventure and find out!

🎁 Join the ChainLemonade Studios group for a free in-game PET! 🎁

🔊 Play with the sound up for the best experience! 🔊

✨ Can you get all TWO endings? Play again to win both badges! ✨

👍 Be sure to like and favorite this game if you enjoyed it! ⭐

💀 WARNING: This game has scary scenes and flashing lights. 💀

🛒 Struggling to survive? Check out the store for some helpful perks to help you survive! 🛒

Tags: Horror, Terror, Scary, Creepy, Adventure, Adopt me, Adoption, Baby, Roleplay adopt me
